description: Start the OAuth connect flow for a platform. Returns a URL — open it in a browser to authorize the account; once approved, it appears in list_social_accounts. Use this to connect a new Instagram/TikTok/X/etc.

external_id.description: Your own reference id to correlate the resulting account on your side.

redirect_url.description: Where to send the user after authorizing (overrides the workspace default).

name: create_auth_url
